category_title: Students who seek autonomy and independent mastery
scenario_title: Informal learning task with constant verbal guidance
minimal_context: Amir is sitting one-on-one with a tutor attempting to solve a Rubik's Cube.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the Rubik's Cube. I will sit here and guide you every step of the way so you can solve it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. I'm just sittin' there trying to solve it. I'll keep trying and trying and trying.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You made a mistake. Let me tell you all these little things you could do to make it easier.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Every time I messed up I got a little more discouraged.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying. I will keep sitting here and guiding you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I gave up on it because I had like lost the little twinkle in my eye about finally solving the Rubik’s Cube and being able to brag to people. I never really started trying again cause I didn’t see the point.
